description: This file declares the INarratorAnnouncementHost interface, which abstracts the announcement host used for accessibility features in the Calculator app. It provides methods to check host availability, create a host instance, and make announcements.

classes.name: INarratorAnnouncementHost
classes.description: An interface that abstracts the narrator announcement host, allowing different implementations depending on OS capabilities.

methods.name: IsHostAvailable
methods.description: Checks if the narrator announcement host is available on the current OS.

methods.name: MakeHost
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of a concrete narrator announcement host.

methods.name: Announce
methods.description: Makes an announcement using the concrete host with the provided NarratorAnnouncement object.
